file(GLOB mplay32_rc_deps resources/*.*)
add_rc_deps(mplay32.rc ${mplay32_rc_deps})

# mplay32.exe is all Rust (mplay32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mplay32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# mplay32.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/mplay32-rust/src/mplay32/mplay32.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(mplay32_res OBJECT mplay32.rc)
target_compile_definitions(mplay32_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(mplay32_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(MPLAY32_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/sdk/lib/crt/CMakeFiles/oldnames.dir/oldnames.a)
add_cargo_module(mplay32 mplay32-cargo mplay32.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE mplay32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mplay32_res ${MPLAY32_REUSED})
